title: New preparation batch
purpose: Create a separate preparation record for physical aliquots; it does not create analytical results or assign tests.

sections.title: Access and fields
paragraphs: Active internal staff with a laboratory role can read this workspace. Analysts can create and change preparation work. An admin has operational analyst access; a client account or superuser status alone does not grant it.
Required fields are marked with an asterisk. Record actual events in the laboratory time zone. A new batch begins with open membership.

items.label: Preparation method
items.description: Required exact active method/version with an active preparation requirement. This determines which tests can later be covered by its aliquots.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Required Water, Wastewater or Soil; every aliquot and covered test must match.

items.label: Actual preparation start
items.description: Optional actual event time; leave blank until preparation starts. It cannot be more than two minutes ahead of the server clock.

items.label: Actual preparation completion
items.description: Optional. Requires an actual start, must be at or after it and cannot be more than two minutes ahead of the server clock. It does not close membership.

items.label: Instrument or equipment
items.description: Optional non-retired equipment, ordered by asset ID. Not recorded is allowed. It is primary equipment attribution for information, not an approval or release condition.

items.label: Notes
items.description: Optional batch notes retained on the batch record.

items.label: Create preparation batch
items.description: Validates the fields, records an attributed creation event, and opens the new P-number. Add aliquots and their covered tests next. Errors keep the bound form available for correction.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to Preparation batches without creating a record.
